gaps.lead: We got to the airport late and missed the flight.
gaps.sentence: If we had got to the airport earlier, we ___ the flight.
gaps.explanation: If + past perfect, would(n't) have + participle.

gaps.lead: The old bridge is still used by locals.
gaps.explanation: Passive is used by locals → active: locals still use.

gaps.lead: Their wedding will take place in June.
gaps.explanation: Weddings/concerts are held: will be held (in June).

gaps.lead: He didn't pass the exam because he hadn't studied.
gaps.sentence: If he ___ , he would have passed the exam.
gaps.explanation: Third conditional: if + past perfect, would have + participle.

gaps.lead: We couldn't go out because of the heavy rain.
The lecture was cancelled because nobody came.
gaps.explanation: because so few people came = because hardly anybody came.
